title: Every invariant record is a schema-valid setpoint citing its authority
statement: Every record under law/invariants/ MUST validate against law/schemas/invariant.schema.json, MUST carry a unique id of the form INV-<DOMAIN>-<NNN> whose domain is declared in the domain taxonomy, a severity from the declared vocabulary, a single canonical statement, and at least one authority anchor that resolves to a heading in a constitution article or an accepted decision record.
rationale: Article 11 makes the invariant the atomic spec unit; ADR-SCR-0004 requires the framework to carry its own records and cite their sources.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
